summary: This 6-K filing by Global Ship Lease, Inc. discloses the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 17, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of three Term III directors, ratification of PricewaterhouseCoopers S.A. as independent auditor, and adoption of the Second Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation. The filing also notes affirmed credit ratings with an upgraded outlook. As a routine corporate governance update with no transaction, special situation category does not apply.
